entries.candidate: MEEZA new data centre at Qatar Science and Technology Park (construction contract to Elegancia Contracting and Industries, over QAR 500 million)
entries.reason: QNA (Qatar's state news agency) reported on 24 September 2026 (local qna-20260924-meeza-elegancia.html) that MEEZA QSTP LLC had awarded the construction contract for its new data centre to Elegancia, a subsidiary of Estithmar Holding, for more than QAR 500 million, citing a company statement on the Qatar Stock Exchange website. The facility is linked to Qatar Science and Technology Park, but no plot, building, address or capacity is given. A contract award supports at most announced status: no site work is reported. The QSE disclosure was not fetched because www.qe.com.qa robots.txt disallows /documents/. MEEZA's own news sitemap has no item for it, and qstp.qa is bot-blocked (robots.txt HTTP 403). QSTP as a whole is a technology-park extent, not a facility locator. This is probably the same 'new Data Centre campus' as the 7 September 8 MW hyperscaler agreement, but that is not established.
entries.reopen_condition: A MEEZA release or an accessible QSE or Estithmar disclosure naming the new data centre (M-VAULT number), together with its QSTP plot, building or Qatar address point, or an operator map; dated within 85 days of the update.
